outgoing.name: London
outgoing.excerpt: Henry Joseph Wood was born on 3 March 1869 in London.

outgoing.name: Norwich
outgoing.excerpt: He conducted many concerts in London and the provinces, and appeared regularly at choral festivals in Norwich and Sheffield.

outgoing.name: Sheffield
outgoing.excerpt: He conducted many concerts in London and the provinces, and appeared regularly at choral festivals in Norwich and Sheffield.

outgoing.name: Wales
outgoing.excerpt: Both parents were keen amateur musicians: his father sang in church choirs and played the cello and his mother sang songs from her native Wales.

outgoing.name: Johann Sebastian Bach
outgoing.excerpt: …when in 1929 he made an orchestral transcription of Bach's Toccata and Fugue in D minor, he presented…

outgoing.name: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky
outgoing.excerpt: …1891, and the following year the English premiere of Tchaikovsky’s Eugene Onegin at the newly rebuilt Olympic Theatre.
